verified_behaviors: Persisted coherence snapshots retain at most 16 validated owner execution rows; omitted historical rows are counted and no history before enablement is reconstructed.
Retained rows preserve the exact service execution identity, owner, trace sequence, outcome and explicit verification status, plus validated resource measurement state when present.
A scoped invocation can match a retained execution by exact identity and owner while latest_trace_relation remains latest-only.
The selected-session projection exposes retained resource status and sample, and the tested compact response preserves the relationship within its byte budget.
The existing vertical proof still resolves, enters, invokes a provider, enforces a protected write boundary, checkpoints, resumes, and hands off a session.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Scoped ambient service evidence outlives the latest scheduler trace
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment owner-pass scheduler and capability-intelligence projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The verified implementation retains exact owner execution records across persisted scheduler traces and adds an explicit retained-trace relationship to the existing session projection.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Allow an ordinary persisted owner pass to populate the new field, then inspect a future session projection for live retained correlations.

measurement_limits: Regression fixtures verify the new retained-match path, but the current durable session has not run a persisted owner pass that populates this field.
Owner execution return and resource samples are not independent verification, service fulfillment, or evidence of reduced agent intervention.
